name: com.mirrahub.cloud-sdk
description:
A cloud backend for games: accounts, saves, economy, leaderboards, social systems, LiveOps and analytics. 23 services, no server of your own.

Self-contained: the native WebView and SQLite plugins it needs ship inside the package, so there is nothing to install alongside it. Do not add net.gree.unity-webview or com.gilzoide.sqlite-net separately — they are already here and would collide.

samples.description: Every one of the SDK's 23 services on a live UI. Built with UI Toolkit and VContainer — VContainer has to be installed separately.
